newsitem.title: FRANCE: Nine wheat ships expected in Rouen by November 16.
newsitem.headline: Nine wheat ships expected in Rouen by November 16.

text.p: Nine ships were expected in Rouen by November 16 to load some 122,000 tonnes of soft wheat, port officials said on Tuesday.
One ship was also expected in Rouen by November 16 to load 1,000 tonnes of barley, they said
Destinations for the wheat and the barley were not specified.
In Rouen nine ships are currently loading a total of 109,000 tonnes of soft wheat destined for west Africa, Italy and Poland.
One ship is also loading 1,300 tonnes of maize destined for Reunion Island.
